outcome: neonatal deaths within the first week of life
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women with twin gestations attending the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at NSCB Medical College & Hospital, Jabalpur.
finding: The study found a high incidence of preterm deliveries, NICU admissions, and maternal complications, highlighting the high-risk nature of twin gestations compared to singleton pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were identified as the most common mode of delivery, reflecting the complexities and risks associated with managing twin births.
followup_time: Up to the first week of life (for neonatal deaths)
